payload.core_mechanism_summary: Recursively compute minimal cost to break n×m rectangle to get k squares. Try horizontal/vertical breaks, distribute k. Memoization on (n,m,k).
payload.rationale: State is defined by two dimensions (n,m) plus k, characteristic of 2D DP. The recursion explores breaking options, akin to dp_2d_state typical in partition/subproblem decomposition over two parameters.
